summary: Universal Tracker: 5/5 backend tests passed (root, trending, series detail extra.number_of_episodes, /api/recommend with seeds, /api/recommend empty seeds). Frontend web-preview flows validated on 390x844 mobile viewport: 5 tabs render (Explorar/Para você/Biblioteca/Favoritos/Quero), Para você empty-state shows foryou-empty with 'Explorar títulos' CTA; on a series detail (Reacher, 32 eps) the ProgressTracker (testID progress-tracker, progress-minus/plus/input/complete/summary) works — +2 shows '2 / 32 episódios' and auto-marks 'Na Biblioteca', 'Concluir' fills to 32/32 with '✓ Concluído'; on a movie detail the ProgressTracker is correctly absent. Review save (testID review-save) shows '✓ Salvo'. Share modal opens (share-card + share-button) and on web shows share-message. Ad banner (testID ad-banner) is present in Explorar footer, Biblioteca footer, Detalhes and Para você. After favoriting Reacher, Para você shows foryou-based-on chips + foryou-section-movies + foryou-section-series with 45+ cards. On Biblioteca the card renders card-progress-series_* with '2/32'. NOTE: while tapping user-rating-8 via Playwright the user-rating-label ('8/10') did not appear and no 'Você 8' text rendered on the library card afterwards — this is very likely a test-automation artifact (the rating pills sit below the viewport fold on the details screen and force-clicks may fall outside the button hit area on RN-Web), not a code bug. E1 should manually verify rating persistence in-app or in Expo Go. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. Books errors (Google Books 403/429) are expected per the request and are not reported.

ui_bugs.issue: During automated testing, tapping user-rating-8 with Playwright force-click did not update user-rating-label to '8/10' and no 'Você 8' was shown on the library card. Screenshot confirms the score buttons row sits below the visible viewport fold on 390x844 (behind the sticky action bar / KeyboardAwareScrollView). Needs manual retest in Expo Go; if reproducible in the real app, ensure scoreRow is not overlapped by the sticky bottom bar (details/[type]/[id].tsx uses paddingBottom: 140 + insets.bottom which should already avoid it, but the score pills at height 40 may still get partially covered by the gradient / stickyBar during small screens).

rca_of_issue: Rating-label not-rendered under Playwright: probable RCA is that user-rating-<N> pills sit below the visible fold on 390x844 because the KeyboardAwareScrollView + sticky bottom bar consume the lower ~140px. Playwright's force-click uses the element's bounding box; when the element is inside a scrollable container but off-screen, .scroll_into_view_if_needed sometimes reports success without actually bringing it above the sticky bar. The rating merge/persistence path in useLibrary.ts:62-80 is correct (patch is spread on top of ensureSaved, which preserves user_rating). Recommended mitigation for the app: on TouchableOpacity press of a rating pill, call a lightweight scrollTo or add scroll-margin so the pill is guaranteed above the sticky bar; alternatively wrap PersonalNotes with a small ref-scroll on focus.
